description: Insert blank rows or columns before a given row number or column letter.

account.description: Google account to use: an email or unique part of one (e.g. "acme.com"). Default: the account that can open the spreadsheet, else the default account.

before.description: Row number (e.g. "5") or column letter (e.g. "C") to insert before

spreadsheet.description: Google Sheets link or spreadsheet ID. The name of a spreadsheet used with Sheets MCP before also works

name: insert_rows_or_columns
title: Insert rows or columns
